newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent dips five cents, eyes on gas oil.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent dips five cents, eyes on gas oil.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures prices were traded slightly lower in late afternoon dealings on Monday after a slightly weaker than expected opening to London gas oil futures.
November had traded just three lots at $23.80 per barrel by late trading, down five cents from London's settlement on Friday at $23.85.
Brokers said the market was likely to remain supported by worries over weak distillate stocks on both sides of the Atlantic and saw Brent November's downside limited to $23.20/$23.30 in coming days.
London gas oil was trading 25 cents either side of its Friday close of $245.50 on Monday after being called to open up $1-$2.
NYMEX November crude, which closed in New York at $24.73, was last traded at $24.83 on ACCESS, unchanged from earlier in the day.
